summary.zh: 排查慢查询，改写 SQL，优化索引与迁移脚本
summary.en: Diagnose slow queries, rewrite SQL and tune indexes or ORM migrations.

description.zh: 针对慢查询或结果错误的 SQL，分析执行计划、索引和写法，给出改写方案；同时能处理 Prisma、Drizzle、SQLAlchemy 的迁移脚本。适合查询变慢、需要从零写一段 SQL，或迁移跑不过的时候。连接线上数据库需要你自行提供地址和权限。
description.en: Explains why a statement is slow or wrong from its plan, indexes and shape, then rewrites it. Also covers Prisma, Drizzle and SQLAlchemy migrations. Use it when a query needs writing or a migration won't run. Database access comes from you.
